title: fix(app-shell): publish review sheet lists no Options change on a picklist-bound field nobody edited
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB4xjiquevJqfBXiUoqfQwa1)_

Fixes #29899

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** Studio 发布审阅面板在比较对象的已发布版和草稿时，把绑定了 picklist 的字段都按"存储形"（不带 `options`）来比，不再把服务端解析出来的选项当成作者改动。
- **为什么改：** 只要对象里有绑定 picklist 的字段，每次发布面板都会多出一行"~ Tier · Options"，作者根本没改过，面板失去可信度，真改了也分辨不出来。
- **风险与回滚：** 只动 `@object-ui/app-shell` 的面板 diff，不改任何写入、协议或存储；只影响声明了 `picklist` 的字段的 `options` 比较。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx` 的 `computeChangeDetail` 开头的 `stored(...)` 两行；新测试 `DraftChangesPanel.picklistServedOptions-29899.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/preview/__tests__/DraftChangesPanel.picklistServedOptions-29899.test.tsx`，预期 3 passed。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

`computeChangeDetail` (the diff behind Studio's publish review sheet) now reads both versions of an `object` in the form the publish door **stores** a picklist-bound field: without `options`. It does so by passing each envelope-free body through `dropServedPicklistOptions` from `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, the function the Studio and Setup writers already use to turn a served object read back into the authored form before a PUT (objectui#10202, objectui#11692). The step runs only when the entry's type is `object`.

The panel already imports from `@object-ui/data-objectstack` (`readDraftChanges`), so the console's eager graph gains no new module.

### Why "compare like with like (both stored)" and not "skip `options` in the diff"

The card offered both. Normalizing to the stored form keeps every real change visible; skipping a key would hide some.

- `dropServedPicklistOptions` touches a field only when **that definition** names a picklist (`picklist !== undefined`, the `FieldSchema` refinement's own test). A field with inline `options` is returned by reference, so a real options change there is still listed. The CONTROL test proves it.
- A field moving between a picklist and inline options still lists **both** `picklist` and `options`, in either direction, because the side with inline options keeps them. A diff-level "ignore `options` when the field declares `picklist`" rule would hide the `options` half of that move. It would also have to choose which side's `picklist` counts.
- The authoring door refuses `picklist` and `options` together, so the stored form of a bound field never carries `options`. Normalizing to it loses nothing an author could have written.

### Mechanism, measured against `origin/main` at `21510bba`

The card's PM assumptions hold:

- **The live read carries the resolved options; the draft read does not.** `readMetaItem` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`) returns early for `state: 'draft'` ("Draft reads stop here"). It serves the converted draft row through `governServedObject` and never reaches the object fold. The active read folds the object through `foldObjectExtendersFromRegistry` → `SchemaRegistry.foldObjectExtendersOnto` → `finishServedObject` → `resolvePicklistFieldsOnto` (`packages/objectql/src/picklist-resolution.ts`). That last step writes the resolved `options` onto each bound field and keeps `picklist`.
- **No path found where the draft itself carries resolved options.** Studio's writers drop them before a save (`dropServedPicklistOptions`), and the authoring door refuses a body that carries both keys. A body that did carry both would also be normalized here on both sides.
- **The fix is not server-side.** Serving the resolved options on a bound field is the declared contract (`PicklistServedFieldSchema`, `@objectstack/spec` `data/picklist.zod.ts`): every object read serves it, and the write door judges values by the same served field. The draft read serving the stored row is ADR-0005's draft lifecycle. Neither read is wrong. The diff was comparing two forms, so the ui lane owns the fix.

## Tests

New file `ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/__tests__/DraftChangesPanel.picklistServedOptions-29899.test.tsx`. It renders the real `DraftChangesPanel` against routes where the published read serves `tier` with resolved options and the draft read serves it stored:

1. A picklist-bound field `tier`, and a draft that changes only `notes.label`: the drill-in renders exactly one row, `~ Again notes notes · Label`, and no `Options`.
2. **CONTROL:** an inline-options select `status` whose options really changed, beside the same bound `tier`: exactly one row, `~ Status status · Options`.
3. `computeChangeDetail` direct: a bound field reads unchanged; bound → inline and inline → bound each list both `picklist` and `options`; the array `fields` shape reads the same.

<details><summary>Ablation (fix removed → new tests red → restored)</summary>

Fix committed first (`f4d64a21`). Then `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` swapped the anchor `type === 'object' ? dropServedPicklistOptions(body) : body;` for `body; // ABLATION-29899` and ran the new file under the verify lock. The test imports the panel by relative path from `src`, so no `dist` rebuild sits between the mutation and the run.

```
ablation-replace: ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob 694ec6852677 -> eb00fb8b831c
     × lists only the label change when the draft edits another field of an object with a bound field
     × CONTROL: still lists an Options change on a field with inline options
     × reads a bound field as unchanged in computeChangeDetail, and keeps a move to or from inline options
AssertionError: expected [ '~ Again notes notes · Label', …(1) ] to have a length of 1 but got 2
AssertionError: expected [ '~ Status status · Options', …(1) ] to have a length of 1 but got 2
AssertionError: expected [ { name: 'tier', …(1) } ] to deeply equal []
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  3 failed (3)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (694ec6852677) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

Without the fix, case 1 renders a second row beside the label row, and case 3 lists `tier` as changed. The CONTROL fails only on its row count: its own `Options` row is still there first, and one more row follows it.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Scope:** this changes only what the review sheet **displays**. The publish door's own no-op test (content hashes of the stored bodies) never read served options and is unchanged.
- **`type` gate:** only `object` bodies are normalized. Its one caller passes `entry.type`. The served picklist form is a property of object reads.
- No out-of-scope findings.

All runs at head `f4d64a21`, from the `ui/` root as `ui/AGENTS.md` prescribes, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.
